tape3.kind: existing pinned symlink input; proposed card change does not alter it

limitations: This review did not read or compare OD numerical arrays.
The resulting SAMPLE=8 case is a diagnostic sensitivity control, not a uniquely signed cubic-isolation experiment.
No solver or build was run.

proposed_control.preserve_exact: All other TAPE5 bytes, all atmospheric/profile records, ICNTNM=1, executable/runtime/data closure, and the pinned TAPE3 bytes remain unchanged.
proposed_control.single_input_edit_only: Replace record 3 columns 21-30 with the ten ASCII bytes ` 8.000E+00`; do not rewrite/reformat any other bytes. Use a new one-use case directory and verify only this byte-range differs from the frozen TAPE5.

scope: Source/deck-only review. No LBLRTM solve, build, or numerical output parsing was performed.

adaptive_and_rounding_behavior: For the first layer, DV is rounded to 3 significant figures and made even through integer IDV scaling (lblrtm.f90:5463-5472).
Later layers adapt DV/ITYPE based on OLDDV/DV ratios, with thresholds 2.5, 1.2, and 0.8; layers can retain previous DV or subdivide/interpolate (lblrtm.f90:5480-5520).
IOD=0 does not take the special IOD=1/2 early path around the adjacent-layer adaptation logic. DVOUT=0 and DVSET=0 remain untouched.
source_interpretation.causal_limit: A 4→8 run would test sensitivity to the documented sampling discretization while preserving all other deck bytes, atmospheric state, executable, runtime data and TAPE3. It cannot uniquely isolate a signed cubic interpolation cause: SAMPLE changes line sampling density and interacts with first-layer rounding and adaptive grid transitions. No claim of cause or correction follows from this control alone.
source_interpretation.cost_and_output: Release notes explicitly warn increased computation time as SAMPLE increases. Higher SAMPLE refines layer line-grid spacing and can increase monochromatic work/output, but exact time/size multiplier is path/profile dependent because rounding and adaptive inter-layer DV/ITYPE logic intervene; no exact multiplier asserted.
source_interpretation.sampling_equation: For IHIRAC=1, OPPATH computes AVBAR from ALBAR and ADBAR (lblrtm.f90:5418-5420), then initial layer DV=AVBAR/SAMPLE (5423-5425). Increasing SAMPLE 4→8 halves this pre-adaptation DV algebraically at otherwise identical AVBAR; it is a spectral sampling-resolution diagnostic.
source_interpretation.supported_range: LBLRTM v12.17 release_notes.txt documents SAMPLE max 32 and gives 8 or 16 as alternatives to default 4. Source input path defaults nonpositive SAMPLE to 4 (lblrtm.f90:912); no additional SAMPLE<=32 guard was located in the inspected source.
